question: Where can I find restaurant inside 100 kilometers while progressing from Taylor's Aquarium, Dunn, NC toward Wake Forest Art & Frame Gallery, Wake Forest, NC?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Taylor''s Aquarium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Dunn%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Wake Forest Art & Frame Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wake Forest%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 100000 ) );
